posts.title: Demo for Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Available for Free!
posts.body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/6d5c2292cd15cace7b6b98676a2a08409cfc19f9.png"][/img][/p][p]A demo for Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok lets you get a taste of the game before its July 9, 2026 release. As a gateway for newcomers to experience [i]Relink[/i], an early portion of the main story and multiple characters are playable in the demo. Each quest grants rewards upon completion that may be redeemed in the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to check out the demo via the "Download Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Demo" button on the store page![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/881020/Granblue_Fantasy_Relink/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Content[/b][/h3][h3]1.　Story Mode[/h3][p]Play through an early portion of the main story from Granblue Fantasy: Relink. Clear story mode to redeem rewards in the full game of Granblue Fantasy: Relink or Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/0d91508c2aa3cff6cf1338daed2c8747b1fc26d9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]2.　Quest Mode[/h3][p]Play through quests either solo or with others. Crossplay matchmaking with other platforms is available in the demo, with a total of 4 different quests to try. Complete the 3 available quests to unlock the 4th quest, "Sephira's Sanguine Glimmer," which allows access to Summons, an all-new battle mechanic. Each quest grants rewards upon completion that may be redeemed in the full game of Granblue Fantasy: Relink or Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/7e46b20762acbd90ab35db3bec0b0c2860a66429.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]3.　Tutorial Mode[/h3][p]Learn game basics, such as how to control characters during exploration and combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/0d436bed6a442bbd7ddda7b0da78a3e64c5ae6ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Official Website[/b][/p][p][url="https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com"]https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839790/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Standard_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4306890/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Special_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

posts.title: Second Trailer “Strength & Darkness”
posts.body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/fcb0d8b8437779664df316bb199ede674d1cd8c6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok | Second Trailer “Strength & Darkness”[/p][previewyoutube="3v--EoDTB5A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Introducing Two New Playable Characters and One New Enemy[/b][/p][p]Fraux and Fediel round out [i]Endless Ragnarok[/i]’s cast of new playable characters, bringing the total to six. Including returning characters from [i]Relink[/i], players can choose from a whopping twenty-nine characters to play as, each boasting their own unique playstyle. When the time comes to face archenemies like The World, players will definitely have strength in numbers.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fraux[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/bb8b1cf43f17127d78614e9fcebba48a4f143261.png"][/img]Pactbearer to The Devil, a primal seeking to create a new world order, Fraux is otherwise an ordinary skydweller whose heart, character, and temperament are filled with love and compassion.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fediel[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/07091181f2d93752c86915b447c0cc2cbbe75353.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The World[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/c5d3e111bb8ce2f02a7fe17717f62888f24d1af1.png"][/img]One of the Arcarum, The World is the plinth and pillar to which the other Arcarum are tied. Originally created by the Astrals in ancient times, it eventually evolved to a state of self-awareness and self-actualization, developing its own identity.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Check the official website for more information![/b][/p][p][url="https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com"]https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok will come out on July 9, 2026. [/p][p][b]Wishlist now![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839790/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Standard_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4306890/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Special_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

posts.title: Open Beta Test Confirmed for Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok!
posts.body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/4cf01a301d5834bb34e4b680633e8280f405f296.png"][/img][/p][p]The beta test is intended to verify network load and game performance on all supported platforms. In addition to all the content featured in the previous closed beta, Summons—helpful allies who can be invoked in combat—will also be made available for the first time.[/p][p][/p][p][b][url="https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com/en/obt/"]https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com/en/obt/[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Four quests will be playable during the open beta. Upon completing the first three, "Sephira's Sanguine Glimmer" will unlock as the fourth quest. The new Summons mechanic will be available in this quest, along with Primal Burst—an enhanced version of the Full Burst which requires full coordination from the party to activate. Additionally, as with the closed beta test, Beatrix will be playable once more.[/p][p][/p][p]The open beta test supports online multiplayer and cross-platform play.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839790/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Standard_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4306890/GRANBLUE_FANTASY_Relink__Endless_Ragnarok_Special_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

posts.title: Known Issues (Updated 7:00 p.m., Feb 22, 2024 [JST])
posts.body:
As of 7:00 p.m., Feb 22 (JST), we're currently investigating the following known issues listed below. We appreciate your patience as we work to address them.

[h3]Trophy/Achievement Issue:[/h3]
・Obtaining loot from destroying parts or rewards after clearing certain quests may cause the Reminiscence trophy/achievement to become no longer obtainable in the way it was intended.
*The False Sword of the Apocalypse, which is paid content, doesn't count toward unlocking Reminiscence. However, if you do meet the trophy requirements, there have been instances of the trophy unlocking upon obtaining the False Sword of the Apocalypse.
*Please note that making purchases to acquire this trophy is neither intended nor required.
*We're working on an update that will award the missing trophy/achievement to players who have already fulfilled its requirements.

[h3]Chapter Select Issue:[/h3]
・Before completing Chapter Ø for the first time, if a player uses chapter select to clear the chapter that comes right before Chapter Ø, and then tries to continue playing through Chapter Ø, this may cause normal progression to break.
*We're working on an update to restore normal gameplay to players affected by this issue.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused. Thank you for playing Granblue Fantasy: Relink!

posts.title: Known Issues
posts.body:
We're currently investigating the following known issues listed below. We appreciate your patience as we work to address them.

Online Multiplayer Issues:
・Some instances of games crashing during multiplayer. 
・Receiving network connection errors when departing on a quest.

Rewards Issues:
・When a player clears a fate episode quest by restarting from a game over, if the player then continues on to another quest and unlocks a new quest difficulty, the rewards for unlocking that new quest difficulty may not be given.
・After getting the message about rewards for unlocking a new quest difficulty, if the player closes the game without saving, those rewards may no longer be obtainable upon reloading.
・Side quest rewards may not be given when playing on Ultimate difficulty from chapter select.
We're working on an update that will allow affected players to obtain the rewards they should have earned.

Steam Issues:
・The game may not run properly after launching.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused. Thank you for playing Granblue Fantasy: Relink!
